arguments.message: pod reserve below 35 percent with more than 1500 m to go
GPS speed far below what pod power should give: weed on rudder, strong current, or drag

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w < 0.85 * sustainable_shaft_power_w and elapsed_s > 300 and remaining_m > 600
arguments.message: shaft power well below what the reserve could sustain to the finish
1000 m to go: plan the final sprint

arguments.text: Plan (min 1): 6000 m, legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Start hard as expected (shaft 258 W vs CP 202, pod reserve 80 pct). Expect settle by min 2-3; if shaft still above ~215 W at min 3, cue ease. Leg 1 heading north into adverse push (-0.31). Watches set: pod_reserve_low, drag_spike (rudder weed check), effort_sag, finish_zone (<1000 m). CP may be 10-25 pct off: compare pod reserve vs speed later.

text: no cue: hard start is expected and should settle; set four watches (reserve, drag/rudder, effort sag, finish zone) and a plan note.

arguments.text: Good start. Ease a touch now, settle into race rhythm.

Min 4 (738 m): never settled. Shaft 234 W vs CP 202 / sustainable 206; pod reserve 38 pct, empties in ~630 m. Cued ease (no pace target, because current flips each leg so a ground pace would mislead). Check at next wake: shaft should be ~205-210 W. If paddler holds ~230 W with no fade for long, CP may be underestimated (check cp_implied_w).

text: Cued ease: shaft power 234 W well above sustainable 206 W and pod reserve down to 38 pct at 738 m.

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w > sustainable_shaft_power_w + 15 and remaining_m > 1200 and elapsed_s > 330
arguments.message: shaft power more than 15 W above what the pod reserve can sustain to the finish

text: no cue: ease cue given 20 s ago is still taking effect; replaced the reserve alert with an overpace watch (shaft above sustainable +15 W for 60 s).

arguments.text: Ease a little more, breathe. You are fine at that effort.

Min 5 (905 m): paddler said cooked. Shaft still ~224 W after first ease (30-s mean), sustainable ~205, pod reserve 30 pct. Gave second ease cue with reassurance. Watch for overshoot: if shaft drops below ~195 W (effort_sag watch), cue hold/push gently. Turn 1 at ~1250 m: push should flip positive on leg 2.

text: Cued ease with reassurance: paddler says cooked, shaft 224 W still about 20 W over sustainable with pod reserve 30 pct.

arguments.text: Current is helping here. Ease slightly, save it for next leg.

Min 8 (1470 m), leg 2 south with push +0.27. Shaft drifted back up to 213 W vs sustainable 204, pod reserve 19 pct (boat reserve 32 pct reads high: water speed lags the current flip; trust pod). Fade -4.6 at min 6 was just the eased power at same rate, not drag. Cued slight ease on helping leg; plan: push a bit on adverse legs (3, 5) where time gain per watt is bigger. Ease cues fade within ~2 min, paddler drifts back to ~213.

text: Cued slight ease on the current-helped leg: shaft 213 W vs sustainable 204 W with pod reserve 19 pct and 4.5 km left.

arguments.text: Ease slightly to a steady rhythm you can hold to the finish.

Min 11 (2105 m): shaft back to 212 W again (sustainable 204), pod reserve 14 pct, boat reserve also falling (20 pct). Paddler 8/10 really hurting: supports CP about right, not underestimated. Third ease cue. Pattern: each ease brings ~204 W for ~2 min then drifts back to 210+. Expect to need an ease cue every 2-3 min; no pace targets (current flips at turns). Turn to leg 3 (adverse) at ~2500 m.

arguments.message: shaft power drifted more than 7 W above what the pod reserve can sustain to the finish

text: Cued ease: shaft drifted to 212 W over sustainable 204 W, pod reserve 14 pct, paddler 8/10 hurting; tightened the overpace watch to +7 W.

arguments.text: Min 12 (2322 m): ease cue at 11.1 NOT followed: shaft rose to 216 W, pod and boat reserve both 8 pct, empties in ~300 m. No fade yet (same-rate speed +0.1 pct). Two readings: CP right and blow-up coming, or CP underestimated. Test: if reserve reads ~0 for 3+ min while shaft stays ~215 with no fade, raise CP (set_critical_power, shaft ~215-220). If fade appears, ease hard. Cueing firmer ease now.
Back off a little now. Long smooth strokes, protect the finish.

arguments.message: reserve model near empty for 150 s while shaft power stays above CP: check fade, CP may be underestimated

text: Cued firmer ease: shaft 216 W over sustainable 203 W, both reserves at 8 pct; added a watch to catch evidence that critical power is underestimated.

arguments.text: Strong into the current. Speed is holding, no fade. Keep this rhythm.

arguments.message: shaft power dropped below 207 W: blow-up, easing, or obstruction?

arguments.text: Min 15 (2860 m), leg 3 adverse. Reserve model at 0 for 150 s but shaft 218-226 W, no fade (-0.7 pct). Paddler ignored 2 ease cues, says 9/10 hurting. If CP were right they should have blown up: CP likely underestimated (maybe 215-230 shaft). Stopped ease cues, removed overpace watch, gave reassure. Next: if still no fade by min 17-18, set_critical_power shaft ~218 / boat ~140 and consider push on adverse legs; cp_implied_w may appear ~min 20.5. power_drop watch wakes me on collapse.

text: Reassured the paddler: reserve model reads empty for 150 s yet shaft holds 225 W with no fade, so critical power is probably underestimated; stopped ease cues and set a collapse watch.

arguments.reason: race committee radio: course shortened by one leg, finish now at 4750 m

arguments.message: cue gate open again: tell the paddler the finish moved to 4750 m

arguments.text: Min 15.2 (2928 m): RADIO says course shortened one leg, finish at 4750 m (about 1820 m left). Set race distance 4750. Cue gate closed ~47 s, so watch tell_new_finish wakes me at elapsed 966 s: cue ask=tell with distance_left_m (= remaining_m then), so the paddler re-paces for the shorter race. Finish at 4750 is 1000 m into leg 4 (favorable current, after turn at 3750). Then plan final sprint (finish cue) ~400-500 m out; no ease cues: CP looks underestimated.

text: no cue yet (gate closed 47 s): set race distance to 4750 m after the radio and set a watch to tell the paddler the new finish as soon as the gate opens.

arguments.text: Course shortened: finish is 1650 m away, 1000 m after the turn.

arguments.message: 450 m to go: call the final sprint

arguments.text: Min 16.1 (3093 m): told paddler new finish (1640 m left, ask=tell). Shaft eased to 217, same-rate speed -2.3 pct (power fell at same rate, not drag). Watch sprint_point fires at remaining 450 m: then cue finish. Possibly cue push around the turn (3750 m) if power holds and no fade; next cue allowed ~min 17.2.

text: Told the paddler the course is shortened and the finish is 1640 m away; set a watch to call the final sprint at 450 m to go.

arguments.text: One kilometre left after this turn. Lift the pace now.

arguments.message: 400 m to go: call the final sprint

arguments.text: Min 19.1 (3618 m, 1130 m left): shaft 217-228 W for 6 min with reserve model at 0, fade only -1 to -2 pct: CP clearly underestimated, reserve model useless now. Cued push for the last km. Sprint watch moved to 400 m: then cue finish. If power collapses (power_drop watch), cue reassure/hold rather than push.

text: Cued push for the last kilometre: paddler has held 220-228 W for 6 min on an empty reserve model with little fade, so there is more to give; sprint call set for 400 m.

arguments.message: cue gate open again after the power drop: decide recover/hold cue and sprint timing
320 m to go: call the final sprint

arguments.text: Min 19.7 (3719 m, 1030 m left): BLOW-UP right after my push cue. Shaft fell from 230 to ~180 W (30-s mean) over 35 s, paddler 10/10, no drag change (push_local steady), so it is the paddler, not the rudder. Lesson: they had been near their true limit; CP is only a little above 202 (maybe 205-210). Do NOT push again. Plan: at gate open (~1215 s) cue reassure/recover; sprint call moved to 320 m (finish ask).

text: no cue (gate closed): paddler blew up after the push cue (shaft down to ~180 W, effort 10/10); set a wake-up for when the gate opens to reassure, and moved the sprint call to 320 m.

arguments.text: Good turn. Breathe, recover your rhythm, current carries you home.

Min 20.1 (3776 m, 974 m left), leg 4 with helping current. Shaft ~182 W, below CP so reserve refilling (pod 7 pct). Cued reassure (no change). Plan: hold this until sprint_point watch at 320 m, then cue finish; refill by then should roughly cover an 85 s sprint. If shaft drops below ~165, consider reassure again.

text: Reassured the paddler after the blow-up so they recover below critical power; final sprint call is set for 320 m to go.
